items.reason: A fragrance-free ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable, smooth-looking skin barrier for oily, sensitive-feeling skin.
A mineral SPF 50 with zinc oxide gives daily sun protection and suits sensitive-feeling skin.
A hyaluronic serum adds a light layer of hydration that can soften the look of fine lines.

response.routine_note: I removed the retinol serum because retinol is not recommended during pregnancy, so it is best to skip it for now and check with your prenatal care provider about what to use. In the meantime, use the hyaluronic serum and moisturizer morning and night, and finish with the mineral SPF each morning to help keep fine lines from looking deeper.
